messages:
morgan: heads-up — PR #842 integration workflow red on main. failing at secrets decrypt step (KMS). logs show AccessDenied when trying to decrypt. ci-bot attached run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/123456789

ci-bot: job integration-tests (run 123456789) failed

morgan: log snip:
```text
[2026-02-15T10:02:33Z] ERROR: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: User "github_app_installation_9876" does not have permission to use key projects/rdw-kms/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/runner
    status: PERMISSION_DENIED
```

devin: ugh. I saw a few flakes earlier but not this. @lina can you check App installation permissions? could be the app lost access after org token rotation.

lina: on it. quick Q — is this only failing on the dedicated runners or all GHA hosted runners?

morgan: all runners in the workflow. both ubuntu and self-hosted pool.

lina: checking org settings... looks like the GitHub App's installation was disabled for the repo by an org policy change yesterday. installer: infra-admin@redwood.io

sam: that would explain short-lived installation tokens failing to auth with KMS IAM. we need to re-grant the app the 'Cloud KMS CryptoKey Encrypter/Decrypter' role on that key. can someone re-install the app? @devin can you ping infra-admin?

devin: pinging infra-admin now — infra-admin, can you re-enable the 'ci-runner-app' installation for repo/rwd-core and ensure the service principal has kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on projects/rdw-kms/*

infra-admin-bot: @devin Request created: https://idp.redwood.internal/requests/5553 — reason: gha runner decrypt errors. ETA 30m

morgan: in the meantime can we rerun the failing workflow to unblock PRs? maybe the token will refresh after re-install.

devin: I'll rerun once infra-admin confirms. command to rerun via CLI:
```bash
gh run rerun 123456789 --repo redwood-inference/core
```

sam: also we should bisect to see when this started. my guess: a policy push yesterday at 02:00 UTC. try listing workflow runs before/after.

lina: confirmed policy change at 2026-02-14T02:05:12Z removed third-party apps from a few repos. re-adding now.

infra-admin-bot: installation re-enabled for repo/rwd-core. applied role binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> serviceAccount:ci-runner@app.eta

devin: rerunning now :arrows_counterclockwise:

ci-bot: re-run queued (run 123456790)

ci-bot: rerun complete — all integration tests passed :tada:

morgan: nice. leaving this thread with action items: 1) infra to add monitor for app installation status 2) add pre-flight check in CI for KMS permission 3) postmortem note in #incidents if any PRs were blocked longer than 15m

lina: will file a followup ticket and add a quick pre-flight check script (check KMS decrypt on CI startup). filing: INT-402

devin: thanks everyone. closing thread.
